FROM dim_product p JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE subcategory='Interior Paint' GROUP BY sku HAVING count(*)>1)
   OR (p.subcategory<>cp.subcategory)

SELECT count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_receipt_lines,
 sum(f.quantity) AS units_all, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity END) AS units_staff,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_rows, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx,
 count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND cp.category<>'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.quantity) u, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) r
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date, units_sold, receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM f) days_fact, (SELECT count(*) FROM r) days_rpt, (SELECT sum(u) FROM f) fact_units, (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM r) rpt_units,
 (SELECT sum(r) FROM f) fact_receipts, (SELECT sum(receipts) FROM r) rpt_receipts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM f JOIN r ON r.business_date=f.sale_date WHERE f.u<>r.units_sold) mismatch_days,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=108) closures,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND NOT is_trading_day) nontrading
